results.title: BestEx Research Launches Pulse AI, the World's First AI-Powered Institutional Trading Analytics Platform
results.author: BestEx Research
highlights:
BestEx Research Launches Pulse AI, the
...
STAMFORD, Conn., Aug. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- BestEx Research Group LLC, an independent provider of execution algorithms, trading technology, and trade analytics for global equities and futures, today announced the launch of Pulse AI, the world's first AI-native interface for institutional trading analytics. Pulse AI connects the firm's Pulse Analytics suite to Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI assistants desks already use, letting traders ask questions and receive answers grounded in BestEx Research's proprietary models and realized market data. It is built to streamline trading cost analytics across the complete lifecycle of a trade, including pre-trade analytics to inform how positions are planned and traded and broker-neutral post-trade transaction cost analysis that supports comprehensive analysis of execution performance across brokers and proposes changes toward cost reduction.
...
Pulse AI's pre-trade analytics capabilities are live for global futures, with equities pre-trade arriving in October. Institutional trading desks work with enormous amounts of market data, and turning data into a decision usually requires quants to spend time extracting it, cleaning it, and building models. Pulse AI Pre-Trade eliminates that, returning analysts' time to perform deep analysis for the trading desk. It streamlines the workflow around liquidity analysis, producing answers to questions like which products tend to be most liquid at a given time of day, how the spread and depth of an instrument typically behave, how a market's liquidity conditions affect cost, the effect of scheduled economic events on the order book, how quickly a large position can be worked across different participation rates, the expected cost of trading at varying speeds, and more. Because Pulse AI draws on BestEx Research's processed algo inputs and execution cost model, the answers reflect current liquidity conditions and arrive with the supporting visualizations and interpretation that a trader and their team would otherwise have to assemble by hand.
...
The other component Pulse AI will bring to traders, scheduled for Q1 2027, is broker-neutral Post-Trade TCA. Fair comparison and evaluation of broker performance has always been a challenge for institutional investors. Each broker measures the flow it executed, using its own methodology, and presents results limited to that slice. A desk working with many brokers ends up with several partial report cards and no way to compare them on equal terms. Broker-neutral TCA puts all of a buy-side firm's execution under a single methodology. Traders can see which brokers actually performed, which strategies worked and under what conditions, and where changing or customizing an algorithm would lower cost. Pulse AI makes that analysis conversational, so the investigation happens in the same AI assistant the trader is already working in rather than in a quarterly report.

# BestEx Research Launches Pulse Analytics, Debuts Next-Generation Market Impact Model Designed for Futures
...
September 10, 2025
...
STAMFORD, Conn., September 10, 2025 /PRNewswire/ – BestEx Research Group LLC, an independent provider of high-performance algorithmic execution and measurement solutions for equities and futures, today announced the launch of Pulse Analytics, a new business line dedicated to pre-trade and execution analytics. Built as an API-first, multi-asset platform, Pulse Analytics is designed to help portfolio managers and traders estimate, measure and improve trading costs. Clients can integrate seamlessly via a REST API—or access Pulse Analytics through BestEx Research’s Algorithm Management System (AMS), the firm’s cloud-based front end.
...
The platform’s first offering, the Pulse Market Impact Model for Futures, is now live, delivering symbol-specific transaction cost estimates that reflect the unique structural nuances of futures markets. The model provides both historical and forward-looking transaction cost estimates, broken down into market impact and order placement cost components. Estimates account for key factors affecting execution cost, such as order size, urgency, duration, and time of day. In addition to cost estimates, the model provides access to other execution-relevant analytics—including trade imbalance, spread, and depth of book—as well as benchmark prices such as VWAP, participation-weighted price (PWP), and arrival price. These capabilities enable institutional traders to back-test strategies with cost awareness, evaluate historical trading costs, and estimate the cost of future trading. Coverage currently includes 70 base futures products across Energy, Agriculture, Metals, FX, Equity Indices, and Interest Rates.
...
While its Futures Market Impact Model is the initial release, Pulse Analytics will expand to include additional asset classes, a broker-neutral transaction cost analysis, execution optimization tools, and futures roll analytics. Institutional traders can explore the full capabilities of the Pulse Market Impact Model—including product coverage, performance metrics, and detailed API documentation—on the firm’s website. Access to the trial environment is available upon request.

results.title: Introducing Pulse AI for Institutional Trading Analytics | Hitesh Mittal posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.author: Hitesh Mittal
highlights: This week, we announced Pulse AI, the world's first AI-native interface for institutional trading analytics. Pulse AI connects our Pulse Analytics suite to Claude, ChatGPT, and the other AI assistants desks already use, so traders can ask questions in plain language and get answers grounded in BestEx Research's proprietary models and historical market data. It opens a third pathway to our analytics suite, alongside our existing AMS and API access. For the last two decades, pre-trade and post-trade tools have often served as compliance evidence for best execution rather than as a way to improve execution or portfolio construction. Pre-trade models were not robust enough to build a portfolio around, so most PMs who needed one have had to build their own. TCA has become a reporting formality, documenting what happened rather than an analysis that informs what you do next. And most of it still arrives as a spreadsheet. But better cost models can create a more useful pre-trade process, and AI can create a better workflow. I've been using Pulse AI myself while we were fine-tuning it, and the combination of robust analytics and AI assistants is incredibly powerful. Analysis that used to take days takes minutes. Over the last month alone we used it to answer client questions on capacity, cost curves, and how liquidity conditions have changed over time. The shift in workflow on our own desk has been the most striking part. Our traders used to go to our quants for any custom analysis, but now they run it themselves. They understand markets and know the right questions to ask; what they didn't have was time to write Python scripts. With AI, that constraint has simply disappeared. At BestEx Research, we're taking a deliberate approach to serving the portfolio managers, traders, and quants who want to improve how they construct portfolios and how they trade. Better algorithms are our bread and butter and will keep lowering trading costs for clients. But I have long believed that even larger effect on portfolio performance will come from better pre-trade and post-trade tools, because the decisions they inform lead to more cost-aware portfolio construction, better trade timing, better broker selection, and better algorithm parameterization. The tools available today are years behind because they were built for a different purpose. That's why we're also investing heavily to extend these capabilities into TCA and other asset classes. Pulse AI will cover global equities in October, followed by a multi-asset TCA platform with an AI-native interface in Q1 2027. If you'd like a demo of Pulse AI, or you're interested in becoming a design partner and shaping how we build out our multi-asset pre-trade and post-trade analytics, send me a message.#pretrade#posttrade#AI#tradinganalytics
